headlines.description: Drew Stanton threw two touchdown passes to Larry Fitzgerald, David Johnson ran for two scores and the Arizona Cardinals capitalized on San Francisco mistakes beat the 49ers 33-21.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cardinals capitalize on 49ers mistakes to win 33-21

events.name: New England Patriots at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: Tom Brady, looking razor-sharp at times and relatively rust-free after serving his four-game "Deflategate" suspension, passed for 406 yards and three touchdowns to Martellus Bennett on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pumped up: Brady passes for 406 yards in return for Patriots

headlines.description: Matt Prater kicked a 29-yard field goal with 1:28 left and Darius Slay made an over-the-shoulder interception on the next snap, helping the Lions to a 24-23 victory over the Eagles on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Prater's kick, Slay's pick give Lions 24-23 win over Eagles

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw a 35-yard TD pass to T.Y. Hilton with 3:43 left Sunday to lead the Indianapolis Colts past the Chicago Bears 29-23.
headlines.shortLinkText: Faster tempo allows Colts, Luck to hold off Bears 29-23

headlines.description: Marcus Mariota threw for three touchdowns and ran for another score, helping the Tennessee Titans overcome a handful of big plays by the Miami Dolphins to win 30-17 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mariota throws for 3 scores to help Titans beat Miami 30-17

headlines.description: Adam Thielen finished with a career-high 127 receiving yards, and the Minnesota Vikings defense flustered Brock Osweiler and the Houston Texans on their way to a 31-13 victory on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings stay unbeaten with easy 31-13 victory over Texans

events.name: New York Jets at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger passed for 380 yards and four touchdowns and the surging Pittsburgh Steelers pulled away in the second half for a 31-13 win over the New York Jets on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Roethlisberger throws for 4 TDs, Steelers blow by Jets 31-13

headlines.description: The Washington Redskins used an 85-yard punt return by Jamison Crowder and an uncharacteristically strong performance by their defense to beat the Baltimore Ravens 16-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Streaking Redskins get defensive in 16-10 win over Ravens

headlines.description: Matt Ryan and the Falcons didn't need another 300-yard performance from Julio Jones to decipher Denver's dazzling defense and wreck Paxton Lynch's first NFL start with a 23-16 win over Broncos.
headlines.shortLinkText: Atlanta Falcons hand Denver Broncos first loss 23-16

headlines.description: Ezekiel Elliott ran for 134 yards and two touchdowns, fellow rookie Dak Prescott threw for a score and ran for another TD, and the Dallas Cowboys beat the Cincinnati Bengals 28-14 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie-led Cowboys are 4-1 after 28-14 win over Bengals

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Oakland Raiders

headlines.description: Derek Carr threw a go-ahead 21-yard touchdown pass to Michael Crabtree on a fourth-and-2 gamble and added another TD pass to Amari Cooper to lead the Raiders to a 34-31 victory over the Chargers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders take advantage of Chargers mistakes in 34-31 win

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Nickell Robey-Coleman returned an interception 41 yards for a touchdown, LeSean McCoy rushed for 150 yards, and the Bills won their third consecutive game by defeating the Rams 30-19 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills top Rams 30-19 for 3rd straight win

events.name: New York Giants at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw two touchdowns passes in an otherwise choppy night for the Green Bay offense, and the Packers' defense rattled the New York Giants and limited Odell Beckham Jr. in a 23-16 vic
headlines.shortLinkText: Offense choppy, Packers D gets to Giants in 23-16 win

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Roberto Aguayo kicked a 38-yard field goal as time expired, and the Tampa Bay Buccaneers defeated the Carolina Panthers 17-14 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bucs beat Panthers 17-14 on last-second field goal by Aguayo
